verdict.rationale: The CRA documents sanctioned third-party channels for acting on a business's behalf. Representatives use the Represent a Client portal to request online access to an account, and businesses can authorize access to their online information. Separately, enrolled EFILE electronic filers using CRA-certified software can file for clients, and filers can file returns or make payments for business clients. missing for 10: detail on how a company grants, scopes, or revokes a representative's authorization; business-specific (not T1-focused) EFILE coverage; independent or hands-on corroboration.
